title: Gym Promo With Visit Details
tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

judge.summary: A welcoming vertical gym promo displays all four details clearly and correctly, though the full text duration and music cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.

must_haves.item: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
must_haves.why: The bright gym features smiling, casually exercising adults rather than intimidating bodybuilding imagery.

must_haves.item: The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
must_haves.why: All four lines appear correctly in both supplied late frames.

must_haves.item: All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
must_haves.why: All four lines are together at 6.3 and 8.8 seconds, but the samples do not establish their onset at 5 seconds or uninterrupted visibility through the end.

must_haves.item: The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
must_haves.why: Large white lettering on a dark translucent panel is readable, well spaced, and comfortably inside the frame.

must_haves.item: The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.
must_haves.why: The portrait format and 10-second duration are established, but the sound transcription does not verify upbeat music or conclusively establish the absence of voiceover.
